data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in order (click Restaurants, type location, select suggestion, open more filters, pick a filter and apply) and names both location and filter as parameters, but its wording is a little vague (for example "Open more restaurants / Show more filters" and no explicit "click filter label"), so an automation would need to guess a few details.
